item.evolvedwarfare.recruitment_contract: Right-click a free recruit in a city,
camp or watchtower to hire them.
gui.evolvedwarfare.button.follow.tip: Follows you everywhere. If left far behind, appears next to you.
gui.evolvedwarfare.button.home.tip: Goes back home and wanders around it.
gui.evolvedwarfare.button.set_home.tip: Makes its current spot its home, and stays there.
message.evolvedwarfare.recruited: %s has joined you. Don't forget to pay them with food!
message.evolvedwarfare.for_hire: %s is looking for work. Hire them with a Recruitment Contract.
message.evolvedwarfare.last_provision: %s was paid with their last provision. Give them more tomorrow.
message.evolvedwarfare.unpaid: %s wasn't paid today. Without pay, they'll leave in %s day(s).
message.evolvedwarfare.deserted: %s left due to lack of pay. Their gear was left on the ground.
message.evolvedwarfare.died: %s has died. Their gear was left on the ground.
item.evolvedwarfare.command_staff.toolti: Right-click: your nearby NPCs follow you.
Click a block: they go and guard it.
Click an enemy: your soldiers attack it.
item.evolvedwarfare.medic_kit.tooltip: Give it to a recruit and train them as a medic.
gui.evolvedwarfare.button.train.tip: Turns them into a soldier based on the weapon in hand: sword = warrior, axe = barbarian, bow = archer, crossbow = crossbowman, medic kit = medic. To give them a trade, use a work post.
message.evolvedwarfare.train_needs_weapo: %s needs a weapon in hand: sword, axe, bow, crossbow or medic kit.
message.evolvedwarfare.staff.guard: NPCs going to guard that spot: %s
block.evolvedwarfare.town_hall.tooltip.0: Pays your NPCs within %s blocks on its own.
block.evolvedwarfare.town_hall.tooltip.1: Store food or coins: tops them up to %s days.
gui.evolvedwarfare.site.area: Area: %s×%s in front of the post
gui.evolvedwarfare.site.help.tool: Their tool goes in their hand; spares go in the supplies.
gui.evolvedwarfare.site.help.storage: Top: supplies. Bottom: output (hoppers pull from below).
gui.evolvedwarfare.button.assign.tip: Puts your nearest recruit (within 24 blocks) to work here.
gui.evolvedwarfare.button.dismiss.tip: Leaves the post: becomes a recruit again and follows you.
gui.evolvedwarfare.button.area.tip: Outlines the work area with particles.
message.evolvedwarfare.site.no_recruit: You have no recruit within %s blocks. Hire one and bring them here.
message.evolvedwarfare.site.dismissed: %s leaves the post and is a recruit again.
message.evolvedwarfare.worker.lost_site: %s has lost their work post and is a recruit again.
profession.evolvedwarfare.farmer.info: Tills soil near water, sows and harvests.
profession.evolvedwarfare.farmer.supplie: Needs: seeds, potatoes or carrots. Extra: bone meal.
profession.evolvedwarfare.lumberjack.inf: Fells whole trees and replants saplings.
profession.evolvedwarfare.miner.info: Digs a 5-step entrance and, underground, a shaft all the way down.
profession.evolvedwarfare.digger.info: Digs dirt, sand, gravel and clay out of a pit.
profession.evolvedwarfare.digger.supplie: Needs: nothing. Much faster with a shovel.
profession.evolvedwarfare.fisherman.info: Fishes in nearby water (4+ water blocks).
profession.evolvedwarfare.fisherman.supp: Needs: nothing. Faster with a fishing rod.
profession.evolvedwarfare.shepherd.info: Shears sheep, milks cows and goats, breeds them.
profession.evolvedwarfare.shepherd.suppl: Needs: wheat and buckets. Shears in hand to shear.
profession.evolvedwarfare.breeder.info: Breeds chickens, pigs and rabbits, collects eggs.
profession.evolvedwarfare.breeder.suppli: Needs: seeds, carrots, potatoes or dandelions.
profession.evolvedwarfare.beekeeper.info: Harvests honey from hives and nests, plants flowers.
profession.evolvedwarfare.beekeeper.supp: Needs: glass bottles (or shears for combs). Extra: flowers.
profession.evolvedwarfare.gardener.info: Harvests melons, pumpkins, cane, cactus, bamboo, berries.
profession.evolvedwarfare.gardener.suppl: Needs: nothing. Replants cocoa and nether wart.
profession.evolvedwarfare.blacksmith.inf: Smelts ores and raw metal into ingots.
profession.evolvedwarfare.blacksmith.sup: Needs: ores or raw metal, and fuel.
profession.evolvedwarfare.cook.info: Cooks meat, fish and potatoes; bakes bread.
profession.evolvedwarfare.cook.supplies: Needs: raw food or wheat, and fuel.
profession.evolvedwarfare.stonemason.inf: Carves stone: bricks, polished stone, sandstone.
profession.evolvedwarfare.stonemason.sup: Needs: cobblestone, stone, andesite, sand... Faster with a pickaxe.
profession.evolvedwarfare.fletcher.info: Makes arrows and gets flint from gravel.
profession.evolvedwarfare.fletcher.suppl: Needs: flint, sticks and feathers, or gravel.
status.evolvedwarfare.waiting: Waiting for something to be ready
status.evolvedwarfare.nothing_here: Nothing to do in the area
gui.evolvedwarfare.site.help.building: Before working, they build their building with materials from the supplies (Building button).
gui.evolvedwarfare.button.building.tip: See or choose the post's building, with a 3D preview.
gui.evolvedwarfare.blueprint.button.prev: Go back to the previous seed's design.
gui.evolvedwarfare.blueprint.button.buil: Their worker will build it before starting their trade, using the materials you put in the post's supplies.
gui.evolvedwarfare.blueprint.button.skip: Work without a building (you can choose one later).
gui.evolvedwarfare.blueprint.button.canc: Leave the building unfinished: what's built stays and the worker starts their trade.
gui.evolvedwarfare.blueprint.button.site: Back to the post menu (storage and worker).
block.evolvedwarfare.warehouse.tooltip.0: Links chests and barrels within %s blocks.
block.evolvedwarfare.warehouse.tooltip.1: Open it to see everything at once, search, take and store.
gui.evolvedwarfare.warehouse.title: Warehouse · %s containers
gui.evolvedwarfare.warehouse.empty: No chests or barrels nearby. Place some within 16 blocks of the warehouse.
item.evolvedwarfare.route_slip.tooltip.h: Click a chest or post: add stop · In the air: edit · Put it in the courier's supplies
gui.evolvedwarfare.route.pickup.tip: Picks up here (from the output, if it's a post). Click: switch to drop off.
gui.evolvedwarfare.route.dropoff.tip: Drops off here (into the supplies, if it's a post). Click: switch to pick up.
gui.evolvedwarfare.route.filter.tip: Filter: click with an item to move only that (empty = everything). Click with an empty hand to clear it.
gui.evolvedwarfare.route.empty: No stops. With the slip in hand, right-click chests, barrels, posts, the warehouse or the town hall to add them. Then put the slip in the courier post's supplies.
profession.evolvedwarfare.courier.info: Takes the posts' output to the warehouse, and brings back what they need and the town hall's pay. With a route slip in its supplies, it follows the route.
profession.evolvedwarfare.courier.suppli: Needs: a warehouse within 48 blocks (or a route slip).
profession.evolvedwarfare.merchant.info: Runs the shop: other players buy what you put in the supplies. Every 2 minutes it sells the warehouse surplus at the market (keeps 64 of each).
profession.evolvedwarfare.merchant.suppl: Put what you want to sell in the supplies; coins come out in the output.
status.evolvedwarfare.route_idle: Following the route: nothing to carry
gui.evolvedwarfare.shop.title: Shop
gui.evolvedwarfare.shop.bundle: How many are sold at once (Shift: backwards)
gui.evolvedwarfare.shop.owner_hint: Whatever you put in the supplies is for sale.
message.evolvedwarfare.shop.closed: The shop is closed: the merchant isn't here.
item.evolvedwarfare.white_flag.tooltip.0: In hand: vikings and pirates won't attack you.
item.evolvedwarfare.white_flag.tooltip.1: Not if you attack them, and bandits ignore it.
message.evolvedwarfare.diplomacy.max: %s: your reputation is already at the maximum.
message.evolvedwarfare.diplomacy.aid: %s: %s warriors arrive to help you (5 min).
message.evolvedwarfare.raid.start.bandit: Bandits are attacking! Defend the settlement.
message.evolvedwarfare.raid.start.viking: War horns sound: the vikings are attacking!
message.evolvedwarfare.raid.start.pirate: Pirates are landing! Defend the settlement.
gui.evolvedwarfare.diplomacy.title: Diplomacy
gui.evolvedwarfare.diplomacy.truce.tip: Pay %s coins: 3 days without attacks or raids. Attacking them breaks it.
gui.evolvedwarfare.diplomacy.alliance.ti: At %s reputation, %s coins: their warriors fight at your side and you can ask them for help.
gui.evolvedwarfare.diplomacy.alliance.ne: Bandits will never be your allies (but they can be bribed).
gui.evolvedwarfare.diplomacy.aid.tip: Allies: %s warriors escort you for 5 minutes. Once a day.
gui.evolvedwarfare.diplomacy.mercenary.t: Pay %s coins: a soldier of your own with their gear (from %s reputation).
item.evolvedwarfare.structure_scanner.he: Right-click two blocks: corners. Click the air: scan. Sneak: clear.
item.evolvedwarfare.blueprint.empty: Blank: scan a building or print one at the architect's table.
item.evolvedwarfare.blueprint.help: Put it in a builder's supplies. In creative, click the ground to place it at once.
block.evolvedwarfare.architect_table.too: Blueprint library: 3D preview, print copies and delete your own.
profession.evolvedwarfare.builder.info: Raises the building from the blueprint in its supplies, block by block, in front of the post.
profession.evolvedwarfare.builder.suppli: Needs: a blueprint and the blocks it uses (see "Missing"). The courier brings what's missing from the warehouse.
status.evolvedwarfare.no_blueprint: No blueprint: put one in the supplies
status.evolvedwarfare.blueprint_missing: That blueprint is no longer in the library
gui.evolvedwarfare.button.area.builder_t: Marks with particles where the blueprint's building will go.
message.evolvedwarfare.builder.no_bluepr: Put a blueprint in the builder's supplies to see where it will go.
gui.evolvedwarfare.scanner.title: Scan Structure
gui.evolvedwarfare.scanner.name: Blueprint name
gui.evolvedwarfare.scanner.hint: The front will face the builder's post.
gui.evolvedwarfare.scanner.cost: Costs 1 paper. Works in all your worlds.
message.evolvedwarfare.scanner.second: Second corner: %s, %s, %s · %s×%s×%s area. Click the air to scan.
message.evolvedwarfare.scanner.need_corn: Mark two corners first (right-click two blocks)
message.evolvedwarfare.scanner.too_far: You are too far from the area
message.evolvedwarfare.scanner.failed: The blueprint could not be saved
message.evolvedwarfare.blueprint.give_bu: Give it to a builder: put it in the supplies of their post.
message.evolvedwarfare.blueprint.missing: This blueprint is no longer in the library
message.evolvedwarfare.blueprint.not_you: Only its author (or an operator) can delete this blueprint
gui.evolvedwarfare.architect.print.tip: Gives you a copy of the blueprint. Costs 1 paper.
item.evolvedwarfare.catapult.tooltip: Lobs stones (up to about 55 blocks) and breaches stone walls.
item.evolvedwarfare.ballista.tooltip: Flat, long shots: heavy damage to a single target, including other engines. Uses bolts.
item.evolvedwarfare.trebuchet.tooltip: Boulders from very far away (up to about 100 blocks). Uses 3 stones per shot and breaks almost any wall.
item.evolvedwarfare.ram.tooltip: Push it to the gate or wall and strike: it breaks up to iron (not obsidian).
item.evolvedwarfare.siege.controls: Right-click: mount · W/S push · A/D turn · Space: fire · Sneak with empty hand: pack up
block.evolvedwarfare.portcullis.tooltip: Iron grate. A winch touching it raises and lowers it.
block.evolvedwarfare.drawbridge.tooltip: Build a rectangle (lying or standing) and put a winch touching it.
Click or redstone: raises and lowers the portcullis or drawbridge touching it.
Place it facing the way the bridge has to come down.
hud.evolvedwarfare.siege.ready: Ready: look at the target and press Space
message.evolvedwarfare.siege.no_ammo: No ammo: load it with right-click or carry it
message.evolvedwarfare.siege.enemy_crew: The enemy is manning it: deal with them first
message.evolvedwarfare.siege.captured: Spoils of war! This engine (%s) belonged to the %s and is now yours.
message.evolvedwarfare.siege.full: It is already full of that ammo
message.evolvedwarfare.siege.under_attac: You can't pack it up in the middle of a fight
message.evolvedwarfare.siege.destroyed: The engine has been smashed to pieces (%s)
message.evolvedwarfare.siege.occupied: Someone is already on the engine (%s)
message.evolvedwarfare.siege.ram_crew: You push the ram yourself: get on it
message.evolvedwarfare.siege.no_soldier: You have no free soldier within %s blocks
message.evolvedwarfare.siege.crew_on: %s now mans the engine (%s) and will shoot at your enemies
message.evolvedwarfare.winch.not_yours: This winch belongs to another player
message.evolvedwarfare.winch.nothing: There is no proper portcullis or drawbridge touching the winch
message.evolvedwarfare.winch.linked_port: Winch hooked to a portcullis (%s blocks)
message.evolvedwarfare.winch.linked_draw: Winch hooked to a drawbridge (%s blocks)
message.evolvedwarfare.raid.engines_left: The raiders left %s siege engine(s) behind: get on and they're yours.
gamerule.evolvedwarfareSiegeBlockDamage: Siege: projectiles and rams break blocks
gamerule.evolvedwarfareSiegeRaids: Siege: raids on towns and castles bring siege engines
item.evolvedwarfare.musket.tip_damage: 5 hearts to the torso (x2.5 head, x0.5 arms, x0.7 legs); knocks back one block
item.evolvedwarfare.musket.tip_reload: Hold right-click to load (uses 1 musket ball, loose or from an ammo pouch)
item.evolvedwarfare.ammo_pouch.hint_inve: In your inventory: right-click with rounds to put them in or take them out
weapon.evolvedwarfare.dagger.tip: Fast. Deals much more damage from behind.
weapon.evolvedwarfare.longsword.tip: Heavy blow, wide sweep and a bit more reach.
weapon.evolvedwarfare.halberd.tip: The longest reach (+2 blocks). Heavy damage against riders and mounts.
weapon.evolvedwarfare.warhammer.tip: Slow; pierces armor (the more armor, the more damage) and knocks back.
weapon.evolvedwarfare.flail.tip: May stun: slowness and weakness for a couple of seconds.
weapon.evolvedwarfare.battle_axe.tip: Heavy damage and disables shields (also chops wood).
weapon.evolvedwarfare.longbow.tip: Arrows fly faster, straighter and hit harder.
weapon.evolvedwarfare.javelin.tip: Hold and release to throw it; pick it up afterwards.
block.evolvedwarfare.research_desk.toolt: Opens your research tree; researches while it stays loaded.
Each bookshelf around it (like an enchanting table): +10%.
research.evolvedwarfare.heavy_weapons.de: Longswords, warhammers, flails and battle axes.
research.evolvedwarfare.polearms.desc: Halberds: the longest reach and heavy damage against riders.
research.evolvedwarfare.archery.desc: The longbow: faster, straighter, deadlier arrows.
The covered battering ram to break gates and walls.
research.evolvedwarfare.counterweight.de: The trebuchet: the heaviest siege engine.
research.evolvedwarfare.incendiaries.des: Fire pots for catapults and trebuchets.
research.evolvedwarfare.fortification.de: Portcullises, drawbridges and the winch that moves them.
research.evolvedwarfare.veterans.desc: Your soldiers gain twice the experience.
research.evolvedwarfare.field_medicine.d: Your medics heal 50% more and your soldiers recover on their own out of combat.
gui.evolvedwarfare.research.title: Research
message.evolvedwarfare.research.busy: You are already researching something else
message.evolvedwarfare.research.unavaila: You must research the previous one first
message.evolvedwarfare.research.cancelle: Research cancelled (%s): you get half back
config.evolvedwarfare.title: Evolved Warfare: configuration
config.evolvedwarfare.reset.tip: Puts everything back as it came
config.evolvedwarfare.server_note: On a server, the server's settings apply: /evolvedwarfare config
config.evolvedwarfare.researchRequired.t: Weapons, engines and fortifications must be researched before crafting.
config.evolvedwarfare.patrolMinMinutes.t: Minimum real minutes between patrols near a player.
config.evolvedwarfare.firstRaidMinutes.t: Real minutes until the first raid can happen.
config.evolvedwarfare.raidChance.tip: When due, chance that a raid happens (if there is something to raid).
config.evolvedwarfare.siegeChanceEasy.ti: Chance that a raid on a town or castle brings siege engines.
config.evolvedwarfare.factionHealth.tip: Health of bandits, vikings and pirates (1 = normal).
config.evolvedwarfare.factionDamage.tip: Damage of bandits, vikings and pirates (1 = normal).
config.evolvedwarfare.settlementBonusPer: Extra health and damage per settlement level (0.1 = 10%).
config.evolvedwarfare.settlementBlocksPe: Distance from world spawn per settlement level.
config.evolvedwarfare.maxUnpaidDays.tip: Days in a row without pay before one of your NPCs deserts.
config.evolvedwarfare.siegeDamage.tip: Damage of stones, fire pots and bolts to creatures.
config.evolvedwarfare.siegeBlockPower.ti: Higher: stones and rams break harder blocks.
Health of catapults, ballistas, trebuchets and rams.
config.evolvedwarfare.siegeReload.tip: Reload time (lower = they fire more often).
config.evolvedwarfare.daggerBackstab.tip: Dagger damage when striking from behind.
config.evolvedwarfare.warhammerArmorPier: Share of the target's armor turned into extra damage.
config.evolvedwarfare.flailStunChance.ti: Chance to stun on each hit.
config.evolvedwarfare.longbowPower.tip: Speed and damage of its arrows (x).
config.evolvedwarfare.locationalDamage.t: Head, torso, arms and legs take different damage (players and the mod's NPCs). Projectiles: where they hit; player melee: where you aim; creature melee: random.
config.evolvedwarfare.locationalVanillaM: Also apply locational damage to zombies, skeletons, villagers, illagers, witches and piglins.
gui.evolvedwarfare.trader.hint_sells: Click: one lot · Shift+click: a stack
gui.evolvedwarfare.trader.hint_buys: Click: one lot · Shift+click: all you carry
message.evolvedwarfare.trader.sold_out: Sold out for today. Restocks tomorrow.
message.evolvedwarfare.trader.no_more: Not buying any more of that today.
config.evolvedwarfare.cityBlocksPerLevel: Distance from world spawn for each city level.
config.evolvedwarfare.cityMaxLevel.tip: Rarer goods unlock at levels 3, 5, 7 and 9 (or at the max, if lower).
config.evolvedwarfare.traderPricePerLeve: How much more traders charge for each city level above 1 (0.10 = 10%).
config.evolvedwarfare.traderMinDaily.tip: Units of each item that traders sell and buy at least every day (they restock every morning).
item.evolvedwarfare.glory_pouch.hint_inv: In your inventory: right-click with coins to put them in or take them out
combat.evolvedwarfare.zone.head: Head
